records.observation: [COVERAGE_MAP160](COVERAGE_MAP.md#L160) calls the daily applied evaluator mandatory; [DAA3](DAILY_APPLIED_ASSESSMENTS.md#L3) explicitly says optional, not a PASS condition, and allows substitution for a transfer drill. The app says optional at [index.html:947](index.html#L947).
records.consequence: There is no coherent per-capability mandatory evaluator contract. Counting the optional task as compulsory would weaken evidentiary rigor.

records.observation: [CHALLENGE35](CHALLENGE.md#L35) says every Day 2–29 capsule has exactly two drills; the four review capsules contain no A/B drills. There are 24 non-review capsules in that interval, with 48 A/B drills, not 56.
records.consequence: Preserve review days; clarify what “module” means instead of inventing eight missing drills.

records.observation: [ASSESSMENTS.md:9–11](ASSESSMENTS.md#L9) assumes two tasks per domain. [A1](ASSESSMENTS.md#L19)–[A2](ASSESSMENTS.md#L23) are Foundations; [A3](ASSESSMENTS.md#L27)–[A5](ASSESSMENTS.md#L35) Statistics/Modelling; [A6](ASSESSMENTS.md#L39)–[A7](ASSESSMENTS.md#L43) RL; [A8](ASSESSMENTS.md#L47)–[A9](ASSESSMENTS.md#L51) Systems; [A10](ASSESSMENTS.md#L55) Architecture.
records.consequence: Baseline maxima are 20/30/20/20/10, not five lots of 20. [A1](ASSESSMENTS.md#L19)–[A10](ASSESSMENTS.md#L55) still total 100. Baseline-versus-final domain comparison and routing are not reliable as written.

records.observation: [CHALLENGE29](CHALLENGE.md#L29) separately names mathematics/statistics and statistical modelling; [ASSESSMENTS.md:10](ASSESSMENTS.md#L10) and final keys combine Statistics/Modelling and use Foundations for mathematics.
records.consequence: Five-domain partition needs one explicit definition. Do not silently recategorize causal [A5](ASSESSMENTS.md#L35) as architecture.

records.observation: [COVERAGE_MAP162](COVERAGE_MAP.md#L162)/169 restricts Review 3 to its listed RL/recovery window; [ASSESSMENTS.md:79](ASSESSMENTS.md#L79) explicitly tests debit/enqueue taught on D20. M37 is assigned D8 but Review 2 window labels M31–M45 without an executable semantic selection.
records.consequence: Window labels and reverse mapping do not agree reliably with actual questions.

records.observation: [PLAN93](PLAN.md#L93)/195/244 allow below-threshold review work with a recovery plan in their Done wording; matrix/keys retain thresholds. App unlocks next day only after PASS.
records.consequence: Recovery progression is ambiguous. A recovery plan must not be treated as a passing assessment.
